newsitem.title: BELGIUM: HOCKEY-WOMEN'S OLYMPIC HOCKEY TOURNAMENT EXPANDED.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-WOMEN'S OLYMPIC HOCKEY TOURNAMENT EXPANDED.

text.p: The Olympic women's hockey tournament will be expanded from eight teams to 10 at the 2000 Sydney Games, the International Hockey Federation (FIH) said on Wednesday.
An FIH statement said the federation had received a letter from the International Olympic Committee (IOC) saying this had been decided at an IOC executive board meeting in Cancun, Mexico, last month.
Women's hockey entered the Olympic programme at the 1980 Moscow Games with six teams and was expanded to eight teams for the 1988 Seoul Games.
